# Report Summary

**Q.1 How does microhabitat affect the transpiration of coast live oak seedlings?**

[**Alternative hypothesis**]{.underline}: The mean transpiration of oak seedlings among different microhabitats does differ.

[**Null hypothesis**]{.underline}:  The mean transpiration of oak seedlings among different microhabitats does not differ.

**Model** = Transpiration \~ microhabitat

**Results**: The mean transpiration of oak seedlings among different microhabitats does not differ, p = 0.1389, df = 2.

**Q.2 Is there a significant relationship between soil moisture and coast live oak seedling transpiration?**

[**Alternative hypothesis**]{.underline}: There is a significant relationship between soil moisture and coast live oak seedling transpiration

[**Null hypothesis**]{.underline}: There is no significant relationship between soil moisture and coast live oak seedling transpiration.

**Model** = Transpiration \~ soil moisture

**Results**: Mean soil moisture failed to predict mean transpiration rate, only explaining 0.087% of the variance (R\^2 = 0.00087) F(1,25) = 0.0218, p-value = 0.8839.

# Scrapping LICOR

## Using Soil Moisture and Height Data

Does coast live oak height differ among treatment and soil moisture?

```{r}
alive_height <- Height_Data_Raw |> #filtering for alive seedlings only
  filter(Dead_Alive == "Alive")

alive_height <- alive_height |>  
  mutate(Treatment = (as.factor(Treatment))) #making treatment a factor
  
levels(alive_height$Treatment) #Adult canopy, dead tree, natural recruits, OA?, open space

alive_height <- alive_height |> #getting rid of NR
  filter(Treatment != "NR") |> 
  select(Date, Block, Tag_Num, Treatment, Sapling_AB_etc, Seedling_Ht_cm, Dead_Alive)

levels(alive_height$Treatment)[levels(alive_height$Treatment) == "OA"] <- "OS" #rename OA to OS

levels(alive_height$Treatment) #it worked yay!
```

Graph

```{r}
height_plot <- ggplot(alive_height) + 
  aes(x = Treatment, y = Seedling_Ht_cm, fill = Treatment) + 
  ylab(label = "Height (cm)") +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_jitter() + 
  annotate("text", x = 3.5, y = 55, label = "A.") 

  

print(height_plot)

alive_height |> #counting obs of each treatment
count(Treatment) #sample sizes are relatively equal

mean_alive_height <- alive_height |> 
  select(Treatment, Seedling_Ht_cm) |> 
  group_by(Treatment) |> 
  mutate(mean_height = mean(Seedling_Ht_cm)) |> 
  select(!Seedling_Ht_cm) |> 
  unique()

```

Analysis

```{r}
aov_model_height <- lm(log(Seedling_Ht_cm) ~ Treatment, data = alive_height)

plot(aov_model_height)

shapiro.test(aov_model_height$residuals) #when not logged, p-value = 0.004

bartlett.test(log(Seedling_Ht_cm) ~ Treatment, data = alive_height) #variance is not equal among #all treatments, p-value = 0.1007

anova(aov_model_height) #mean height does differ between microhabitat

#which treatment is different?
TukeyHSD(aov(log(Seedling_Ht_cm) ~ Treatment, data = alive_height))
#open space differs!
```

Regression

```{r}

moist_wanted <- moist_wanted |> 
mutate(Date = if_else(Date == as.Date("2026-10-21"), #changed to correct date
                          as.Date("2026-10-15"), 
                          Date))


moist_wanted <- moist_wanted |> 
  rename(Treatment = treatment) #renaming col 

#creating colomn with mean soil moisture
moist_wanted <- moist_wanted |> 
  mutate(across(c(VWC1_perc, VWC2_perc, VWC3_perc), as.numeric)) |> #converting chrtr to #numeric in order to add and get mean
  mutate(mean_moist = (rowSums(across(c(VWC1_perc, VWC2_perc, VWC3_perc))))/3) |> #calc mean
  select(Treatment, Date, Block, mean_moist) #issue, we have multiple means for the same treatment and block, we need to take the average of those or remove wonky ones

moist_wanted <- moist_wanted |> 
  filter(mean_moist > 0.0) #removing wonky 0 moisture value since it is the same of two treatment/block, duplicate recording

dt_blk_2 <- moist_wanted |> 
  filter((Treatment == "DT" & Block == "002") | (Treatment == "AC" & Block == "008")) |> #isolating weird duplicate rows
  group_by(Treatment, Date, Block) |> 
  summarize(mean_moist = mean(mean_moist)) #now have mean of duplicates

#filtering out weird duplicates from moist_wanted
moist_wanted <- moist_wanted |> 
  filter(!(Treatment == "DT" & Block == "002")) #getting rid of duplicates

moist_wanted <- moist_wanted |> 
  filter(!(Treatment == "AC" & Block == "008")) #getting rid of duplicates

#adding in correct mean data (dt_blk_2)
moist_wanted <- rbind(moist_wanted, dt_blk_2)


moist_ht_df <- full_join(moist_wanted, alive_height, by = join_by("Block", "Treatment")) #joining height and moisture dfs  

moist_ht_df <- moist_ht_df |> 
  select(Treatment, Block, Seedling_Ht_cm, mean_moist, Date.x) |> 
  drop_na() #got rid of any NA values within height OR moisture


moist_ht_bef <- moist_ht_df |> 
  filter(Date.x == as.Date("2026-10-08")) |> 
  select(Date.x, Treatment, Block, mean_moist, Seedling_Ht_cm) 

moist_ht_aft <- moist_ht_df |> 
  filter(Date.x == as.Date("2026-10-15")) |> 
  select(Date.x, Treatment, Block, mean_moist, Seedling_Ht_cm) 


moist_ht_bef.lm <- lm(Seedling_Ht_cm ~ mean_moist, data = moist_ht_bef)
moist_ht_bef.lm
summary(moist_ht_bef.lm)

moist_ht_aft.lm <- lm(Seedling_Ht_cm ~ mean_moist, data = moist_ht_aft)
moist_ht_aft.lm
summary(moist_ht_aft.lm)
```

Graph

```{r}
before_moisture <- ggplot(moist_ht_bef) + 
  aes(x = mean_moist, y = Seedling_Ht_cm) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) + 
  xlab(label = "Mean Moisture") + 
  ylab(label = "Seedling Height (cm)") + 
  annotate("text", x = 3, y = 55, label = "B.") 

plot(before_moisture)


after_moisture <- ggplot(moist_ht_aft) + 
  aes(x = mean_moist, y = Seedling_Ht_cm) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) + 
  xlab(label = "Mean Moisture") + 
  ylab(label = "Seedling Height (cm)") + 
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = 55, label = "C.")

plot(after_moisture) 

?annotate
```
